Cosmic Six – Innovating Beyond Earth

We are Cosmic Six, a team of innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our mission is to develop a health monitoring solution for astronauts that tracks vital signs, visualizes health trends, and provides timely alerts to support astronaut well-being and safer space exploration.

United by creativity, teamwork, and curiosity, we aim to turn innovative ideas into meaningful solutions beyond Earth.
